scenes.summary: Cafe scene — progressive shot scale from establishing to close-up, building intimacy

shots.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a cozy cafe interior at sunset. Warm yellow pendant lights, wooden tables, barista counter in background. A few customers. Establishes the intimate, warm atmosphere. Cinemaic, photorealistic 24fps.
shots.negative_prompt: empty room, harsh lighting, cold blue light, cluttered frame

shots.prompt: Medium shot of a young man in a dark coat standing at the cafe counter talking to a barista. Waist up visible, his expression and gestures clear. Background shows the cozy cafe environment. Warm lighting. Cinematic, photorealistic 24fps.
shots.negative_prompt: close-up, extreme wide shot, cold lighting, expressionless face

shots.prompt: Close-up of a young man's face in a warm-lit cafe. He is smiling warmly, eyes slightly crinkled. Background is softly blurred, creating emotional intimacy. Catchlight visible in eyes. Warm, intimate atmosphere. Cinematic, photorealistic 24fps.
shots.negative_prompt: wide shot, medium shot, blurred face, emotionless expression, cold light
